dimension_evidence.page: Specifications: Dimensions; manufacturer door-open/closed photos; Rigaku Journal 34(1) 2018 pp.28-29
dimension_evidence.facility_detector: flat HyPix-6000, active window 77.5 x 80 mm, detector distance 35-140 mm per facility #42
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Manufacturer cabinet envelope. Flat detector follows facility photo/JSON rather than current Arc150 product gallery. Source barrel/goniometer/cryostream structure follows manufacturer views; hidden internals, kappa static inclination and motion interlocks are schematic.

notes: Exact DW architecture: one dual-material rotating-anode X-ray source, auto-switching dual-wavelength optic, Cu/Mo; not two independent sealed tubes and not renamed Synergy-R.
Manufacturer explicitly says only one source is used. Four-circle kappa goniometer and HyPix detector retained.
One right-hinged access door verified in manufacturer open-door photo. X-ray emission disabled in model; digital door/axis replay is not a radiation safety or hardware interlock test.

Digital demonstration detector limits are deliberately narrower than published hardware values: theta +/-1.6rad and distance 90-140mm with new 140mm neutral park. Published -148/+159deg and 35-140mm remain source metadata. Detector group and each sample axis are mutually exclusive; discrete triangle sampling does not certify continuous or physical safety.

Inferred kappa housing was oversized and crossed the fixed beam path at rest. Compact tapered support replaces that bulk; sample point/axes/light path stay fixed. Digital kappa range is [-.65,+.05]rad, while prior +/- .65rad remains explicitly illustrative history.
